name: qa-notifications
description: Notification testing across email, SMS, push and webhooks: Mailpit inboxes, Twilio test numbers, FCM, APNs and Web Push, and signed webhook delivery. Covers in-app notifications and legacy MailHog in references, and both webhook senders and receivers. A critic agent (notification-delivery-critic) flags missing idempotency keys, bounce handling, and other delivery defects.
